exampleSentence: Quick, grab the rope before it slips away.
exampleTranslation: 快，抓住绳子，别让它滑走。

exampleSentence: The dancer moved across the stage with natural grace.
exampleTranslation: 那位舞者以自然优雅的姿态在舞台上移动。

exampleSentence: My brother is in the fifth grade at the local school.
exampleTranslation: 我弟弟在当地学校读五年级。

exampleSentence: The road has a steep gradient near the top of the hill.
exampleTranslation: 这条公路在山顶附近的坡度很陡。

exampleSentence: The noise gradually faded as the train moved away.
exampleTranslation: 火车驶远后，噪声逐渐消失。

exampleSentence: She plans to graduate from college next June.
exampleTranslation: 她计划明年六月大学毕业。

exampleSentence: Rice is the main grain grown in this region.
exampleTranslation: 水稻是该地区种植的主要谷物。

exampleSentence: Good grammar makes your writing easier to understand.
exampleTranslation: 良好的语法能让你的文章更容易理解。

exampleSentence: One gramme equals one thousand milligrams.
exampleTranslation: 一克等于一千毫克。

exampleSentence: My grandfather still plays old jazz records on his gramophone.
exampleTranslation: 我祖父仍然用他的留声机播放老爵士乐唱片。

exampleSentence: Their granddaughter visits them every Sunday.
exampleTranslation: 他们的孙女每个星期天都来看望他们。

exampleSentence: My grandfather taught me how to fish.
exampleTranslation: 我祖父教我钓鱼。

exampleSentence: My grandmother makes the best apple pie in town.
exampleTranslation: 我祖母做的苹果派是镇上最好吃的。

exampleSentence: She takes her grandson to school every morning.
exampleTranslation: 她每天早上送孙子上学。

exampleSentence: The kitchen counter is made of polished granite.
exampleTranslation: 厨房台面由抛光花岗岩制成。

exampleSentence: The foundation will grant him a scholarship next year.
exampleTranslation: 该基金会明年将授予他奖学金。

exampleSentence: She picked a ripe grape from the bunch.
exampleTranslation: 她从那一串里摘了一颗熟葡萄。

exampleSentence: The graph shows how sales changed over the year.
exampleTranslation: 这张图表显示了全年销售额的变化。

exampleSentence: Pencil leads are made from graphite mixed with clay.
exampleTranslation: 铅笔芯由石墨和黏土混合制成。

exampleSentence: The child grasped my hand tightly at the crossing.
exampleTranslation: 过马路时，那个孩子紧紧抓住我的手。

exampleSentence: The children played barefoot on the soft grass.
exampleTranslation: 孩子们赤脚在柔软的草地上玩耍。

exampleSentence: A green grasshopper jumped onto the leaf.
exampleTranslation: 一只绿色的蚱蜢跳到了叶子上。

exampleSentence: She expressed her gratitude with a handwritten note.
exampleTranslation: 她写了一封亲笔信表达感激。

exampleSentence: They placed fresh flowers on the grave.
exampleTranslation: 他们在坟墓上放了鲜花。

exampleSentence: The path was covered with loose gravel.
exampleTranslation: 小路上铺满了松散的砾石。
